name: claude-hr
description: claude-hr distribution: curated, minimal-footprint plugins for software and security work.

plugins.name: hr-core
plugins.description: Three read-only subagents (explorer, log-triage, security-reviewer), seven skills (six manual-only), and a Bash secret-leak and git-safety guard.

plugins.name: hr-gates
plugins.description: One end-of-turn hook: format changed files with the repo's own formatter, run the repo's trusted fast checks, metadata-only audit trail. Zero context cost.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: OPTIONAL (profile lean-output). Third-party 'laziest solution that works' behaviour skill, pinned to a reviewed commit. Changes how the model writes code, not just how many tokens it uses.
